This is a long dictation to test the full pipeline with a minute of speech. Contaflow helps small companies keep their books in order. Every morning the team checks the bank feed, matches each payment to an invoice, and flags anything that looks wrong. Pablo Pérez wrote most of the importer, and Francisca Ugarte reviews the monthly reports before they go to clients. The backend runs on Supabase, and the workers run on a small cluster that we manage with kubectl. When a deploy goes out, we watch the error rate for ten minutes, then we post a short note in the team channel. If something breaks, we roll back first and ask questions later. The goal is simple: no client should ever see a wrong balance. That is the whole job, and it is a good one. Thanks for listening to this long test clip, and have a nice day.
